messages:
Aisha (Finance): Quick check — spotted a $48,000 "reserved capacity" credit posted to ledger for ACCT-98765 but it did not offset INV-2026-02-14. Need confirmation if this credit should be applied to the Dedicated subaccount or whether manual allocation is required before EOM.
BillingBot: ledger record -> CREDIT-RESV-2026-04 | acct: ACCT-98765 | scope: contract | amount: 48000.00 | used: 0.00 | expires: 2026-05-15 | status: unallocated
Tom (Infra): Is this a contract-level commitment credit (tied to CRC-2025-789) or a one-off adjustment? If contract-level, we should map to subacct via contract mappings.
Mira (Sales): It's from the Dedicated renewal (CRC-2025-789), committed 12mo. Sales triggered the credit in Jan.
Luis (CloudOps): FYI we've hit a tag-mapping issue in the billing pipeline: contract-scoped credits aren't propagating to region-tagged subaccounts (us-west / eu-west). That explains why INV-2026-02-14 (dedicated-usw) shows no credit.
Aisha (Finance): Confirmed: INV-2026-02-14 (ACCT-98765-dedicated-usw) shows full charge. Requesting: 1) verify ledger allocation; 2) attempt provider reapply for Feb invoice; 3) if not possible, create a credit memo and pro-rate remainder across next 3 invoices. Must consume credit before 2026-05-15 expiry.
BillingBot: Export snippet -> CREDIT-RESV-2026-04 | acct: ACCT-98765 | scope: contract | amount: 48000.00 | used: 0.00 | expires: 2026-05-15
Tom (Infra): If provider can't reapply retroactively, Finance can post an internal negative line item. Which does Finance prefer? Provider reapply avoids manual audit trail work.
Mira (Sales): Customer expects the Feb invoice to reflect the credit. They already queried us. Sales requests provider-first approach.
Luis (CloudOps): Attaching mapping guidance. Use this query to pull per-subacct usage tokens and invoice ids:

SELECT invoice_id, subacct, product, usage_tokens, tags
FROM billing.usage
WHERE invoice_date = '2026-02-14' AND org = 'ACCT-98765';

We can compute pro-rata by usage_tokens per subacct.
Aisha (Finance): I'll run that query and reconcile. Also need CRC-2025-789 contract PDF and the credit issuance email for audit before issuing any manual memo.
Mira (Sales): Uploaded: /shared/contracts/CRC-2025-789.pdf and the credit approval email to sales/credit-memos/.
Tom (Infra): Draft adjustment example for manual path: "CREDIT MEMO — Reserved capacity correction — INV-2026-02-14 — apply -$28,500 to dedicated-usw; remaining -$19,500 to be pro-rated over INV-2026-03-14, INV-2026-04-14." Adjust amounts based on usage export.
Aisha (Finance): OK. First step: open ticket with provider to request reapply. If rejected, we'll post the internal credit memo and pro-rate remaining balance. Also requesting legal for expiry extension if needed.
BillingBot: Created FIN-TKT-8891 | "Reserved credit not applied to INV-2026-02-14 — request provider reapply / manual credit memo" | assigned: Aisha | cc: Tom, Mira, Luis | SLA: 5bd
Mira (Sales): I'll tell the customer we paused collections until resolution. :pray:
Luis (CloudOps): Will deliver usage export + region tag dump by EOD.
Aisha (Finance): Once ledger numbers reconcile I'll post allocation schedule here. Thanks everyone.
